candidates.title: Will Carlos Alcaraz win at least 2.5 more games than Taylor Fritz?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Carlos Alcaraz across the full match is above 2.5 games in the Taylor Fritz vs Carlos Alcaraz professional tennis match in the 2026 Paris Masters Quarter Finals, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Taylor Fritz vs Carlos Alcaraz professional tennis match in the 2026 Paris Masters Quarter Finals. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.05 per reception constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 20 receptions. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout.
